Definition: Japhia, the name of a Canaanite, an Israelite, and a place in Palestine
BiblicalUsage: Japhia is the name of a son of David, born in Jerusalem and listed among his children. The same name belonged to a Canaanite king of Lachish who fought against Joshua, and to a town on the border of Zebulun. One name covers a king's enemy, a king's son, and a town.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that God takes names from every side of the story, and a name that once belonged to an enemy can belong to a son of David. The same word can mark a battle and a birth, and God keeps both.
